# before

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/before>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

Allen BEFORE: this event ends strictly before the related event begins (a gap between them). Transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:after`](gmeow-after.md). (= [time:intervalBefore](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalBefore) over the events' extents; TimeML TLINK relType BEFORE; TEO before.)
